scripts.build: npm run build:circuit && npm run build:program
scripts.build:circuit: xark --version | grep -q '^xark 0\.3\.' || { echo 'needs xark 0.3: see ../RUNBOOK.md' >&2; exit 1; }; xark build circuits/transact && xark setup circuits/transact --r1cs-form reduced && (cd circuits/transact && cargo run -q --release --example demo) && xark export circuits/transact --crate-name shielded-transfer-transact-xark-verifier && xark client circuits/transact --out client/
scripts.build:program: cd program && mkdir -p target && touch src/lib.rs && cargo build-sbf --arch v3 >target/build-sbf.log 2>&1; s=$?; cat target/build-sbf.log; test $s -eq 0 || exit $s; ! grep -q 'overflows the maximum allowed frame space' target/build-sbf.log || { echo 'a stack frame passes the SBF limit of 4 KiB: see ../RUNBOOK.md' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.test:circuit: xark test circuits/transact && cd program && cargo test -q --release
scripts.fmt:check: for m in $(git ls-files '*Cargo.toml'); do cargo fmt --check --manifest-path $m || exit 1; done
scripts.clippy: for m in $(git ls-files '*Cargo.toml'); do cargo clippy --manifest-path $m --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings || exit 1; done
scripts.check:clients: git diff --exit-code -- client/ && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- client/)"
